training.batch_sampling: Four recordings per class, no extra class weights; same51 steps/epoch
training.label_scope: Publisher recording presence; positive bags can contain negative windows
training.negative_loss: softplus(max window logit), same pool as positives
training.negative_sampling: Same full cached-bag maximum selection as positives
training.optimizer: Adam 0.001, clipnorm1, dropout0.0, L2 .0001; balanced expected class mass
training.positive_audit: Per-step pooling weights, selected starts and effective count; not audible annotations
training.positive_sampling: Select full cached-bag maxima every update; recompute all tied maxima with gradients
training.selection: Minimum development consistent_max_balanced_loss, every2 epochs, all cached contexts
